propositions: rebar verify-commit-ticket fails with 'ticket store not found' in a fresh linked worktree because pure intercepts skip the centralized mount step
The mount step is replicated per dispatch-arm and entirely skipped by pure intercepts, making the 'command forgot to mount store' bug structurally possible
A central CLI choke point must run the MOUNT half of initialization (ensure_initialized with init_only=True) before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch, covering every store-touching command
Commands that must not auto-mount (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must be explicitly excluded from the central mount gate
The central mount gate must respect REBAR_TRACKER_DIR override to avoid affecting tests and embedding use cases
